project.name: Member invite expiry
project.description: Invites expire after a per-tenant TTL, admins manage pending invites in the portal, old invites are backfilled. Spec: specs/invite-expiry.md

epics.title: Expiry model and schema
epics.summary: Policy and columns everything else builds on.

tickets.title: Invite expiry policy in members-domain
tickets.description: Pure functions: `expiresAt(createdAt, ttlDays)`, `isExpired(invite, now)`, and a `InviteTtlDays` schema bounded 1..30 with default 7.
acceptanceCriteria: `expiresAt` adds exactly ttlDays days in UTC across a DST change (Vitest)
`InviteTtlDays` rejects 0 and 31 and accepts 1 and 30
`isExpired` is false one millisecond before expiresAt and true at expiresAt

tickets.title: Add expires_at and invite_ttl_days columns
tickets.description: Additive, idempotent migration: nullable `member_invites.expires_at`, `tenant_settings.invite_ttl_days int not null default 7`.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration applied twice to a fresh tenant database produces both columns once
Existing invite rows keep expires_at null after the migration
Migrate runner applies it to all staging tenants with zero failures

epics.title: Write and enforce expiry
epics.summary: New invites carry an expiry, old ones are backfilled, accept enforces it.

tickets.title: Set expires_at on invite create and resend
tickets.description: Create and resend use-cases compute expires_at from the tenant's invite_ttl_days.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating an invite in a tenant with TTL 3 stores expires_at = created_at + 3 days
Resending an invite resets expires_at from the resend time

tickets.title: Backfill expiry for existing invites
tickets.description: One-off job per tenant: set expires_at = created_at + TTL for rows where it is null, and mark rows already past it as `expired`.
acceptanceCriteria: After the backfill no invite row has a null expires_at
Invites older than the TTL have status `expired`; younger ones stay `pending`
Running the job twice changes nothing the second time

tickets.title: Enforce expiry on accept behind invite-expiry flag
tickets.description: Accept fails with `InviteExpired` and marks the invite `expired` when past expires_at and the flag is on.
acceptanceCriteria: With the flag on, accepting an expired invite fails with `InviteExpired` and the invite status becomes `expired`
With the flag off, an expired invite can still be accepted

tickets.title: Make expires_at not null
tickets.description: Follow-up migration after the backfill has run on every tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: The migration fails fast with a clear message if any tenant still has null expires_at
After it runs, inserting an invite without expires_at is rejected by Postgres

epics.title: Admin and invitee surfaces
epics.summary: Portal management, TTL setting, expired-link page and API field.

tickets.title: List, resend and revoke pending invites use-cases
tickets.description: Use-cases for the portal: list pending invites with expires_at, resend, revoke.
acceptanceCriteria: List returns only pending invites, soonest expiry first
Revoke sets status `revoked` and a revoked link cannot be accepted

tickets.title: Pending invites table in the portal
tickets.description: Table under Members with email, invited by, expires in, and resend and revoke actions.
acceptanceCriteria: A tenant admin sees each pending invite with a relative expiry (e.g. 'in 3 days')
Resend updates the expiry in the table without a page reload
A member without admin role does not see the table

tickets.title: Read and update invite TTL use-cases
tickets.description: `getInviteTtl` and `updateInviteTtl` in feature-members, validated with `InviteTtlDays`, so the portal never touches tenant_settings directly (rule apps-no-direct-db).
acceptanceCriteria: `updateInviteTtl(14)` persists invite_ttl_days = 14 for the current tenant
`updateInviteTtl(45)` fails with `InvalidInviteTtl` and writes nothing
Only tenant admins can call `updateInviteTtl`; others get `Forbidden`

tickets.title: Invite TTL setting in portal settings
tickets.description: Setting in tenant settings to change the invite TTL, calling `updateInviteTtl` from feature-members.
acceptanceCriteria: Saving 14 persists invite_ttl_days = 14 for the tenant
Entering 45 shows a validation error and saves nothing

tickets.title: Expired invite page
tickets.description: Accept route renders a clear expired message with a 'request a new invite' action that notifies the inviter.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening an expired link shows the expired page, not a generic error
Clicking 'request a new invite' sends one notification to the inviter

tickets.title: Return expires_at from POST /v1/invites
tickets.description: Add `expires_at` to the invite response and the OpenAPI document.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /v1/invites` responds with an ISO 8601 `expires_at`
The field appears in the generated OpenAPI document
